summary: Markets look broadly risk-on for crypto, with Bitcoin holding strength and altcoin narratives still active, while macro commentary points to a softer dollar and supportive liquidity backdrop. Today’s strongest visible themes are HYPE, TAO, ZEC, NEAR, SOL, and LINK, while XRP sentiment is mixed to bearish and equities remain led by Nvidia strength.
